issue_context.title: moving grouped elements jumps
issue_context.body:
steps:

1. create 2 elements and group them
2. try to move them

![excal_group_jump_bug](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5153846/85526535-6219af00-b60a-11ea-9d6b-2e393e24ef48.gif)

if (2) doesn't result in jump, try to drill down the the group first by double-click, then click away and try (2) again.
comments: This looks like a behavior I had while developing #1788 and fixed for ungrouped elements. 🤔
@dai-shi yes, it seems introduced in the grid PR.

review_comments:
What we need is to get all selected elements, but if we try to `getSelectedElements` right in the `onPointerDown` handler, `this.state` won't reflect the changes to `state.selectedElementIds` we do in several places.

So I hacked it by getting the selected elements in the `onPointerMove` handler, hoping the `state` is updated by this point. Not sure if this is deterministic.
